title: Repo Scaffolding
note: Scaffold four deployable service repos; no bio-core monolith remains.
cadence: foundation; applies to all deployment cadences

title: Contracts & Events
note: Define shared contract packages and event families consumed by all four services.
cadence: foundation; applies to all deployment cadences

title: Infrastructure
note: Define always-on vs exam-window infrastructure and spin-up/spin-down gates.
cadence: foundation; applies to all deployment cadences

title: Observability & Audit
note: One telemetry/audit standard across portal, admin, exam runtime, and proctor.
cadence: foundation; applies to all deployment cadences

title: Security Baseline
note: Deny-by-default authz, secret handling, threat model, and DPDP/security gates for all services.
cadence: foundation; applies to all deployment cadences

title: Mobile OTP Login
note: Student/guardian OTP login lives in always-on portal; exam/admin consume signed claims or introspection only.
cadence: always-on

title: Registration Profile
note: Student profile and eligibility data originates in portal and is synchronized as claims/read models.
cadence: always-on

title: DPDP Consent & Retention
note: Portal captures student/guardian consent; proctor and admin enforce biometric/data-retention obligations.
cadence: always-on

title: Admin Auth & RBAC
note: Admin authentication and privileged RBAC live in bio-admin; proctor review roles consume admin claims.
cadence: admin/curation/results/ops; low baseline outside exams, scale for authoring/results/ops

title: Sessions & Tokens
note: One shared token/session model: portal/admin issue sessions; exam/proctor validate claims fail-closed.
cadence: shared identity/foundation cadence

title: Question Bank
note: Question authoring, answer keys, imports, and versioning are admin-only.
cadence: admin/curation/results/ops; low baseline outside exams, scale for authoring/results/ops

title: Paper Builder
note: Paper assembly and marking policy are admin-owned; exam consumes key-stripped published snapshots.
cadence: admin/curation/results/ops; low baseline outside exams, scale for authoring/results/ops

title: Scheduling, Slots & Pricing Source
note: Admin owns schedule/slot/pricing source of truth; portal consumes catalog, exam consumes runtime windows.
cadence: admin/curation/results/ops; low baseline outside exams, scale for authoring/results/ops

title: Publishing Snapshots
note: Admin publishes immutable key-stripped exam snapshots to exam and public slot/catalog projections to portal.
cadence: admin/curation/results/ops; low baseline outside exams, scale for authoring/results/ops

title: User & School Management
note: Admin manages schools/cohorts/admin users; portal consumes eligibility and school projections.
cadence: admin/curation/results/ops; low baseline outside exams, scale for authoring/results/ops

title: Dashboard Analytics
note: Admin owns analytics/read models across registration, attempts, scoring, and proctor signals.
cadence: admin/curation/results/ops; low baseline outside exams, scale for authoring/results/ops

title: Marketing Discovery
note: Always-on public marketing and discovery.
cadence: always-on

title: Slot Catalog
note: Portal lists admin-published slots and exposes availability for booking and exam handoff.
cadence: always-on

title: Booking & Seat Holds
note: Portal owns atomic holds/booking; confirmed bookings become exam entitlements.
cadence: always-on

title: Razorpay Payments
note: Portal owns payment/order/webhook/reconciliation; admin reads revenue, exam receives paid entitlement only.
cadence: always-on

title: Confirmation, Admit Card & Notifications
note: Portal owns confirmations/admit-card notifications; exam validates admit/check-in data.
cadence: always-on

title: Refunds & Cancellations
note: Portal owns refund/cancellation money flows and entitlement revocation events.
cadence: always-on

title: Registration Entitlement Sync
note: Portal emits paid entitlement; exam start gate consumes it; admin audits/reports it.
cadence: always-on

title: Pricing & Coupons
note: Portal owns coupon/early-bird math while admin owns base slot price/policy.
cadence: always-on

title: Runtime Dashboard Handoff
note: Exam owns readiness/check-in/runtime handoff; portal links students into it.
cadence: exam-window runtime; spin up before check-in, scale down after submission/export gates

title: Device & Identity Check
note: Exam owns preflight/readiness; proctor provides biometric/device signals where enabled.
cadence: exam-window runtime; spin up before check-in, scale down after submission/export gates

title: Attempt Entitlement Gate
note: Exam owns attempt start and validates portal entitlements plus admin slot/snapshot windows.
cadence: exam-window runtime; spin up before check-in, scale down after submission/export gates

title: Player & Autosave
note: Exam owns student player and raw-answer durability; admin/scoring later consumes submissions.
cadence: exam-window runtime; spin up before check-in, scale down after submission/export gates

title: Durable Timer
note: Exam owns server-authoritative timer and auto-submit; admin/ops monitors it.
cadence: exam-window runtime; spin up before check-in, scale down after submission/export gates

title: Submission & Post-Exam
note: Exam owns submit/finalize; admin scoring consumes submission; portal shows post-exam state.
cadence: exam-window runtime; spin up before check-in, scale down after submission/export gates

title: SEB Lockdown
note: Exam owns lockdown enforcement; admin configures requirement; portal surfaces guidance.
cadence: exam-window runtime; spin up before check-in, scale down after submission/export gates

title: Async Scoring
note: Scoring is trusted/admin-side so answer keys never enter the student-facing exam runtime.
cadence: admin/curation/results/ops; low baseline outside exams, scale for authoring/results/ops

title: Results, Ranking & Certificates
note: Admin owns release/rank/certificates; portal displays released results; proctor holds can block release.
cadence: admin/curation/results/ops; low baseline outside exams, scale for authoring/results/ops

title: Face Enrollment
note: Proctor owns enrollment/embeddings; portal captures consent; exam invokes readiness; admin audits.
cadence: exam-window + post-exam review/retention workers; scheduled deletion/DSR jobs may run outside windows

title: Frame Analysis & Match
note: Proctor owns ML inference/risk signals; exam sends frames/events, admin reviews aggregate state.
cadence: exam-window + post-exam review/retention workers; scheduled deletion/DSR jobs may run outside windows

title: Events, Risk & Integrity
note: Proctor owns proctor events/risk; exam attaches attempts, admin consumes integrity signals.
cadence: exam-window + post-exam review/retention workers; scheduled deletion/DSR jobs may run outside windows

title: Review Console
note: Proctor owns review workflow; admin shell may deep-link/embed; result holds flow to admin/portal.
cadence: exam-window + post-exam review/retention workers; scheduled deletion/DSR jobs may run outside windows

title: Biometric Retention
note: Proctor owns biometric deletion/proof; portal consent and admin DPO workflows trigger/read it.
cadence: exam-window + post-exam review/retention workers; scheduled deletion/DSR jobs may run outside windows

title: Exam-Day Ops & Incident Response
note: Admin owns command center/runbooks/controls; all runtime services emit signals and accept governed controls.
cadence: admin/curation/results/ops; low baseline outside exams, scale for authoring/results/ops
